changelog: Rate music albums (derived from their tracks, least-restrictive) so parental controls no longer hide album containers that lack a rating; music now browsable for restricted users. Music rating fields are dropdowns.
description: Fills in missing parental ratings for music (Deezer), movies & shows (TMDb), and anime (MyAnimeList) so parental controls work across the whole library.
name: Chaperone
overview: Automatic parental ratings across music, movies, shows, and anime.
